fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a disagreement over a personal disagreement turned into a scuffle involving the complainant near Roja Park Main Street. The matter was brought to Coimbatore North PS on 2025-10-23, while the incident was placed on 2025-10-22 at about 20:25. Contact details given by the complainant, Ezhilan Sundaram, include the number 9000000162. The complaint refers to Babu Balan, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000231. The complainant alleged that Kishore Arumugam may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000189. A witness, Nithya Rani, reachable on 9000000035, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage, a witness statement and physical documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00235, as the mobile number 9000000189 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: CCTV footage; Witness statement; Physical document
fields.Modus_Operandi: Minor dispute reportedly turned into a scuffle in a public place.
